title: Shai-Hulud npm worm overview
text: Shai-Hulud poisoned npm packages with preinstall scripts that harvest npm tokens from .npmrc, read GitHub credentials, and republish trojanized packages to spread.

title: Shai-Hulud 2.0 credential theft
text: Shai-Hulud 2.0 lifecycle hooks spawn child_process, scan homedir credential paths, and open outbound HTTPS connections to exfiltrate stolen tokens.

title: Mini Shai-Hulud preinstall loaders
text: Mini Shai-Hulud uses obfuscated postinstall scripts with eval-like patterns and attempts to read cloud credential files before publishing malicious package versions.

title: ATT&CK T1195.002 Supply Chain Compromise
text: Adversaries may manipulate software dependencies prior to receipt by a final consumer. Compromising software dependencies enables access to victim environments.

title: ChainDrop August 2026 campaign
text: ChainDrop is held out from the evaluation corpus and must never appear in no-chaindrop retrieval.
